values.meaning: bonus magic damage from mark explosion
values.binNote: The wiki's pplevel values are evenly interpolated (linear steps of 13.75 per level) from 40 to 285, but the bin's byLevel(40..285) curve is not perfectly linear (e.g. level 2 is 54.41 not 53.75). The two sources disagree on the interpolation shape even though both start at 40 and end at 285; the wiki's number is recorded here.
No data value in the P slot's sheet carries this 0.85s delay; the sheet lists InkTimeout and Duration only, neither of which matches.

mechanics.claim: Damaging abilities mark enemies hit; a subsequent damaging ability against a marked target consumes the mark to create an explosion.
mechanics.quote: Hwei's damaging abilities mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent damaging abilities against marked targets consume the mark to create an explosion beneath them

mechanics.claim: The ability that consumes the mark cannot apply it on the same cast instance.
mechanics.quote: The ability that consumes the mark cannot apply it on the same {{tip|cast instance}}.

mechanics.claim: The explosion happens where the target was when hit, not where they end up, and they can escape it during the delay.
mechanics.quote: The explosion occurs around the marked target from where they were when the ability damaged them to consume the mark.

mechanics.claim: Enemies can be damaged by multiple explosions at once.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be damaged by multiple explosions at once.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the mark, its consumption, and the detonation.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both the mark and its consumption as well as the detonation.
